messages:
incident-bot: PAGE: gpu-pool-eu-west1 saturation detected — queue growth 8.3x over 10m, avg wait 22s, autoscaler error: 'scaleup blocked: pool_cap=10 reached' — https://dash.internal/redwood/queues?pool=eu-west1

alice (oncall): ack — I'm taking it. appears paging spike at 04:12 UTC. anyone see provider errors?

bob (sre): looking at autoscaler logs now. seeing repeated "quota limit reached" and a 403 from cloud-provider when creating new instance groups.

carol (eng-runtime): confirmed. model-serving autoscaler attempted to create pool id p-0a9f but API returned "limit_exceeded: maximum pools per region". eviction backlog started at 04:10.

alice (oncall): can we do a manual hotfix? easiest immediate: offload best-effort tenants to cpu fallback model and enable shedding for free-tier.

deploy-bot: runbook triggered by alice: /playbooks/capacity/eviction-step1

bob (sre): manual scale attempt:
```
curl -X POST https://infra.internal/api/v1/pools/scale \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \
  -d '{"region":"eu-west1","delta":2}'
```
-> response: 403 {"error":"pool_quota_exceeded","limit":10}

carol (eng-runtime): ok. do we have warm spare in another region we can route to? cross-region adds latency but keeps SLA.

alice (oncall): yes — we can reroute 10% low-pri traffic to eu-central-1 via routing rule. I'll push canary policy.

alice (oncall): pushing routing change now — will follow up with rollout check.

alice (oncall): rolled 10% reroute. monitoring latency and error counts.

dave (support): seeing increased 429s from some enterprise customers (cust-a, cust-b). opening customer tickets and marking as "investigating / infrastructure".

erin (product): notify PS for impacted accounts? we should also prep a short status update for affected customers.

bob (sre): autoscaler log snippet:
```
2026-03-15T04:11:02Z ERROR autoscaler.go:443 scaleUp: rpc error: code=PermissionDenied desc="pool limit reached"
2026-03-15T04:11:03Z WARN eviction.go:78 queue_len=3563 head_wait=22.4s
```

carol (eng-runtime): suggestion: enable temporary per-tenant rate-limits and prefer cached responses. we have a feature flag for "burst-shedding" — toggling to on for 30m.

alice (oncall): enabling burst-shedding for free+trial tiers now.

alice (oncall): burst-shedding on. observe immediate drop in queue growth.

deploy-bot: policy change deployed: feat/ops/burst-shedding (sha:abc123)

bob (sre): can we also spin up stand-by nodes using a different cloud account? it's manual but possible as emergency.

carol (eng-runtime): yes — we can provision ephemeral capacity in partner-account-2. i'll start the infra ticket; ETA ~18m.

alice (oncall): starting customer comms draft — @erin i'll hand off to you for final wording.

erin (product): got it. i'll post an interim status message in status.redwoodinc.com and ping PS.

dave (support): linking affected ticket ids: #1492, #1493, #1494. all show 429/timeout starting 04:10.

alice (oncall): handing over paging to bob — i'm on for 15 more mins then need to sleep. bob please take over and continue mitigation.

bob (sre): taking over. i've got autoscaler and infra tickets. continuing monitoring.

pagerduty: Handoff: alice -> bob (channel: #incidents) at 04:25 UTC

bob (sre): quick status: reroute 10% low-pri to eu-central, burst-shedding enabled, plan to provision ephemeral in partner account.

carol (eng-runtime): ephemeral provision started. kickstarted via:
```
cargo run --bin infra-provision -- --region eu-west1-partner --count 3
```

deploy-bot: ephemeral nodes booting, health checks passing.

bob (sre): queue length steadying but still above normal. ETA for ephemeral capacity to register: ~12m.

alice (oncall): thanks bob — leaving for now. good notes in thread.

bob (sre): ephemeral capacity attached at 04:50 — autoscaler accepted new nodes, queues draining.

bob (sre): closing immediate pager — metric recovery observed: queue back to baseline ~05:05 UTC, error rates down.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: GPUs in eu-west1 returned to normal. root cause suspected: provider-side pool quota unexpectedly enforced after recent rollout of multi-pool feature.

carol (eng-runtime): postmortem snippets: timeline, immediate mitigations (reroute, burst-shedding, ephemeral nodes), permanent actions: request quota increase from provider, add cross-account fallbacks, improve autoscaler errors to fail open for transient provider quotas.

erin (product): action item: comms sent to impacted customers and PS. draft saved: https://docs.internal/incident/2109876543

dave (support): please add support-runbook notes for identifying customer errors vs rate-limits.

bob (sre): open action items:
- ACTION-1: provider quota request (carol)
- ACTION-2: autoscaler change to differentiate hard vs transient quota errors (bob)
- ACTION-3: add cross-region cold pool + routing playbook (alice)
- ACTION-4: support runbook updates + customer comms template (dave + erin)

carol (eng-runtime): adding tickets now.

alice (oncall): tagging this for postmortem writeup. i'll start timeline & raw logs export.

bob (sre): posted final summary to #postmortems; will coordinate writeup. cc @erin @carol

erin (product): thanks all. recommend we schedule a 30-min blameless review tomorrow.

dave (support): noting: #cust-a asked for compensation. PS needs timeline. saving notes.

incident-bot: auto-generated incident report: https://incidents.internal/2109876543/report

bob (sre): last note — we should add an alert for "autoscaler quota 4xx" to page earlier next time. filing alert task.

carol (eng-runtime): agreed. adding to backlog.

alice (oncall): thanks team. handing off final ownership of action items to carol & bob.

bob (sre): ack. closing thread.
